bugs.summary: Catalog panel exposed lens type/add-on history but not product name, price, lens type, or description editing.
bugs.rootCause: No product editor existed in the catalog configuration panel; product edits were only reachable through the legacy Products sub-tab.
bugs.fix: Added a database-backed product editor to CatalogPricingPanel using the product primary key and verified returned values after update.

bugs.summary: Unwanted zero-price Single Vision Lite remained active in billing.
bugs.rootCause: The supplied seed intentionally created the zero-price item and no archive migration followed the later business decision.
bugs.fix: Applied migration 0006 to deactivate only that catalog row while preserving its history.
